svg.title: City Compressed Into A Barcode
svg.desc: Rectangle aspect ratios reach 54 against the usual maximum 8. Recursive Peano traversals are compressed into tall slivers beside broad maze fragments, making space allocation itself look like corrupt encoded information. Native toolbar flow: nested path echoes → mirrored, compressed recursion.
